About Wakana

Soul & Life Coach
from Japan, based in the USA

It took me half a century to arrive here. I spent years chasing success, achieving goals, and still feeling empty inside. A divorce, burnout, a leap of faith to Hawaii — and there I met my husband.

Even after fulfilling my lifelong dream of international marriage and living abroad, I still wasn't at peace. That's when I truly understood: happiness cannot come from the outside.

Today, I guide others on their journey inward — through Universal Law, mindfulness, and self-acceptance.

  • Certified Soul & Life Coach
  • Universal Law · Note Meditation · Self-Acceptance
  • International marriage & expat life · 10+ years
  • Sessions in English & Japanese
  • Based in Arkansas, USA

2012

After graduating from coaching school and stepping into my first steps as a new coach, I hired a coach of my own.
It made sense — if I was going to guide others, I should experience the journey myself.

It didn't work at all.

At the time, I was carrying a weight I couldn't put into words — a deep sense of worthlessness, of running on empty. I had hired someone who seemed to have it all together. And maybe that was the problem.

Somewhere inside me, a quiet voice was crying out:

"Someone who's always had it easy will never understand my pain."

That experience changed everything. I stopped looking for someone to give me the answers and started walking my own path — through mindfulness courses, self-coaching, and years of quiet inner work.

That long, winding road brought me here.

And because of it, I understand your pain — not from a place of theory, but from lived experience. I'm not someone who had it all figured out from the start. I'm someone who found her way through the dark, one step at a time.

That's who I want to be for you.

Philosophy

Universal Law ×
Mindful Living

Happiness is not something you find outside yourself — it already exists within you. My coaching is rooted in Universal Law, the teachings of Buddha, and the power of self-acceptance.

01

Inside First

True fulfillment begins within. When your inner world is aligned, your outer reality naturally transforms. Everything starts from your vibration — your energy — in this very moment.

02

Self-Acceptance

Stop fighting yourself. Fear, anxiety, worthlessness — these are not enemies. They are messages from your soul. When you allow yourself to truly feel them, something quietly shifts.

03

Universal Law

It is not your thoughts but your vibration that creates your reality. Align your frequency with joy and abundance, and watch your world transform — effortlessly and naturally.

"Every feeling is joy.
Simply being alive fills me with gratitude and wonder.

The moment I stopped fighting myself
and simply accepted who I am —
everything began to shift."

— Wakana Morrison

My Story

Half a Century
to Find
My Way Home

I was a "happiness wanderer" myself. Every step of that journey has made me who I am today.

In My 20s

Lost & Searching

Failed job hunting, couldn't find love, nothing worked out. I decided to armor myself with success — achieving top sales rankings, getting married. But no matter what I accomplished, I felt empty. Burnout. Divorce.

The Turning Point

A Leap of Faith to Hawaii

Through a vision quest journal practice, a powerful message came: "Go to Hawaii." With nothing but a credit card and courage, I went — and met my husband there. Two weeks later, he proposed.

The Dream & Reality

Dreams Fulfilled — Yet Still Empty

My lifelong dream of international marriage and living abroad came true. But even then, my heart wasn't at peace. That's when I finally understood: happiness cannot be found on the outside.

The Discovery

Self-Acceptance Changes Everything

Through Universal Law, the teachings of Buddha, and Note Meditation, I discovered I had been fighting myself all along. The moment I stopped and simply accepted myself as I am — everything shifted.

Today

Living From the Inside Out

Every feeling is joy. Simply being alive fills me with gratitude. It took half a century. But I am living proof that your life can change at any moment — starting now. And I am here to walk that path with you.
